run_host: tcovert + Ti180 J484 Dev Kit (JTAG data, COM6 ctrl)

config.board: Efinix Titanium Ti180 J484 Development Kit
config.accel_config: tinyml_core0_define.v resnet8-only: conv 16x8 STANDARD, ADD STANDARD, RS STANDARD, FC/MUL/LR/MIN_MAX DISABLE (FC in software), FIFOs 64/36, cache 4096, AXI_DW=512
config.data_transport: JTAG bulk load to DDR (untimed); UART control only

notes: Every number from the on-chip CLINT timer around Invoke() only, summed/recorded per image across the batch. Unlike the UART harness's constant-input 'T' run, this throughput is over n distinct images. JTAG/UART transport excluded.
